games.title: CRASH
games.pitch: dodge the tasks, drink the coffee, don't get cooked.

games.title: tab hoarder
games.pitch: stack browser tabs on a tired computer. overhang gets cut. miss once and you're cooked.

games.title: bellchain
games.pitch: hit one bell, it hits the next one. you are now a bell manager.
games.controls: tap or click a bell to ring it. space rings a random bell, m mutes. tap upgrades to buy them.

games.title: Handbag Havoc
games.pitch: granny on a mobility scooter bowls garden gnomes into each other with her purse. it's self-defence.
games.controls: wasd / arrows or drag anywhere to steer. 1 2 3 to pick upgrades. r restart, p pause, m mute.

games.title: fathom
games.pitch: submarine duel where every miss tells you how close you were. decoys lie. so will you.
games.controls: tap or click the enemy sea to fire. arrow keys + enter also fire, s toggles sonar. drag subs to move, tap to rotate.

games.title: +1 Speed Keyboard Escape
games.pitch: every key is +1 speed. esc is further than you think.
games.controls: tap, click or space to jump (hold for a longer jump). crash runs by himself. p pause, r restart, m mute.

games.title: desktop jam
games.pitch: tap your desktop icons until they leave. final_FINAL_v3.docx is in the way. it always is.
games.controls: tap or click an icon to slide it off in its arrow's direction. keyboard: arrows move the cursor, enter/space taps, r restarts, p pauses, m mutes.

games.title: only 1% can close this pop-up
games.pitch: 30 fake pop-ups, 5 seconds each. the x runs away. so will your confidence.
games.controls: tap / click to close, drag where it says drag. enter or space starts and retries, m mutes.

games.title: crash cheats at tic tac toe
games.pitch: beat crash at tic tac toe. he deletes your x's, fakes lag, spills coffee and blue-screens when he's losing. good luck.
games.controls: tap / click a square · keys 1–9 or arrows + space
